_comment: The one place the language model is configured. Both readers use it: the chat planner that turns a sentence into a job, and the design agent. The environment variables CHATDFT_LLM_BASE / CHATDFT_LLM_KEY / CHATDFT_LLM_MODEL take priority over this file. Every model in [model, ...fallback_models] is tried in order, so a rate limit on one does not stop a run. Copy this file to data/llm.json and put your own key in `key`. data/llm.json is gitignored because it holds a live credential; this template is what ships.
